messages:
Amelia: Hey folks — first day setup question. My dock (from the new hire box) powers the laptop but the external monitor only wakes if I unplug and replug the dock power. Also the secondary monitor flickers every few minutes. Anyone seen this with the USB-C ProDock units? Shipping tag 5T-HP-BOX.

sasha_it: Welcome Amelia! Sorry for the hiccup. Can you confirm the dock model printed on the label? Also quick checks: 1) is the dock power LED solid? 2) try `sudo fwupd get-devices` then `sudo fwupd update` if a firmware shows up.

Amelia: Label says ProDock-UD5 v2. LED is amber sometimes, sometimes off. Ran fwupd — it reports no updates. Did a hard reboot and the monitor wakes only after I unplug the dock power and plug back in.

it-bot: New IT ticket created: #44521 — "ProDock-UD5 intermittent power/monitor flicker" — assigned to sasha_it.

sasha_it: Thanks — I pulled the ticket. Two quick things: can you swap the DP/HDMI cable between monitors to see if the flicker follows cable or monitor? Also try disabling the laptop lid-sleep policy for a test: `sudo pmset -a lidwake 0` (mac) / tell me if you're on Linux/Windows.

Amelia: Swapped cables — flicker stayed on the right monitor, so seems monitor or dock port. I'm on macbook (Ventura). Did the pmset change, no difference. Attached two photos of the dock LED and a short video of the flicker: https://files.redwood.internal/up/IMG_001.jpg  https://files.redwood.internal/up/flicker.mp4

sasha_it: Got the media, thanks. Next step: we'll swap the dock with a tested spare and include a power adapter from the office (sometimes the shipped brick is flaky). I'll PM you a pickup window for the faulty dock and a prepaid return label. ETA for exchange: 2 business days.

nick-oncall: I bumped this to expedited shipping and left a spare adapter at the front desk in SF (label: AMELIA-NEWHIRE). If you're local, you can pick it up today after 3pm.

Amelia: Oh perfect — I'm in SF. I'll swing by if pickup helps. Thanks!

it-bot: Ticket #44521 status updated: in_progress -> awaiting_shipment.

sasha_it: If the spare adapter still shows flicker when attached, we'll swap the dock entirely. Keep the video if it still happens so we can log the regression.

Amelia: Will do. Quick unrelated q — who should I ask about VPN split-tunnel rules for internal tooling?

sasha_it: Ping platform-security or DM me, I can start the request. For now, we can do a temporary allow to your device while the dock ticket is open.

Amelia: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:
